english.title: Attempt w/o written consent of authorised officer deface / obliterate / remove paint / stamp / clip / tag on animal

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: Examination for Residues and Maximum Residue Limits

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: A fine.

Time Limit on Prosecutions
No prosecution shall be begun after the expiry of -

(a) three years from commission of the offence; or
(b) one year from its discovery by the prosecutor,

whichever is the earlier.

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
